newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac says Q1 reasonably on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac says Q1 reasonably on track.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Monday trading in the three months ended December 31 was "reasonably on track".
"We are reasonably on target for what we have been expecting in the first quarter," Westpac managing director Bob Joss told reporters.
Joss said the Australian economy had been slower and credit growth had been limited.
There had also been some pressure on margins but the bank had been working very hard to increase efficiency, Joss said.
He did not provide any further details on first quarter trading.
Westpac announced a 19.5 percent rise in net profit to A$1.13 billion for the year to September 30, 1996 but warned that fierce competiton would flatten profits in the year ahead.
